services.name: Fishing Reports
services.desc: I was born and raised here in our great state of Florida. As a 4th generation Florida native, I grew up on the water … whether fishing for reds on the Gulf coast, duck hunting on the Ocklawaha River, or spearfishing and diving for lobster on the Atlantic coast … I’ve just about done it all. Fishing has always been a passion of mine and I love spreading that passion to other people. After high school, I joined the military and spent the next 22 years as a Professional Mariner. I served on a wide spectrum of Army vessels ranging from Hovercraft, LARC-LX, and finished out my career as a First Mate on a 174 foot Landing Craft. services.name: Snorkel trip
services.desc: The sport season, better known as “mini season,” is the last consecutive Wednesday and Thursday of July. These are the only two days of the year that lobster season is open solely to recreational anglers. Starting August 1, commercial lobster anglers are able to set their traps and begin fishing. The two days of mini season and the first week of opening season are highly sought after dates because the lobster populations are at their peak and angler’s limits are almost always reached within an hour or two.
